title: Mirum Pharmaceuticals to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
summary: Mirum Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: MIRM), a leading rare disease company, today announced that it will participate in the following upcoming investor conferences: H.C. Wainwright 4th Annual BioConnect Investor Conference : Tuesday, May 19, 2026 Company fireside chat starting at 3:30 p.m. ET 2026 RBC Capital Markets Global Healthcare Conference : Wednesday, May 20, 2026 Company fireside chat starting at 1:35 p.m. ET The fireside chats will be webcast live and can be accessed by visiting the Investors section of Mirum’s corporate website. The archived webcasts will be available for replay. About Mirum Pharmaceuticals Mirum Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ: MIRM) is a leading rare disease company with a global footprint of approved products and a broad pipeline of investigational medicines.
